**Created**: [DATE]<br>
**Initiative / scope**: `[initiative-id]` / `[common or domain]`<br>
**Reviewed documents**: [`common/initiative.md` or `<domain>/spec.md`, and the plan, tasks, integration matrix or decisions that were read]

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command from the initiative documents and the requested focus.<br>

**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete, and it does not change the initiative state.

## [Category 2]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- Checkbox state is reviewer-owned: no command changes a marker
- A later run of `/speckit-checklist` with the same focus appends items and continues the numbering
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
